name: Methi Thepla
steps: Measure the ingredients, reserving a little flour from the listed amount for dusting where needed. Mix the salt into the flour.
Wash, dry and finely chop fenugreek. Mix with the flours, curd, turmeric and cumin; add water gradually and knead to a soft dough.
Divide the dough into 8 portions, or 12 for thepla. Keep unused dough covered with a damp cloth to prevent cracking.
Rest covered for 15 minutes, divide into 12 balls and roll thinly on a lightly floured surface.

Cook on a medium-hot tawa for 1–2 minutes until the first side sets. Turn, brush lightly with oil, and cook the other side for 1–2 minutes. Turn again until brown spots form and there are no wet dough patches.
Keep cooked breads wrapped in a clean cloth while finishing the batch. Serve warm; oil and water needs vary slightly with flour freshness.
tips: Cook one small test portion first and adjust the consistency and heat before cooking the rest.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
